title: docs(changelog): add the eleven changes 18.5.0 shipped with no CHANGELOG line, and an 18-5 page erratum
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9EaC9kmPYBDw3v97tMkTaQu)_

Fixes #33903

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：18.5.0 已发布但发布说明漏记的 11 条变更，补进 14 个包的 CHANGELOG 18.5.0 节（私有包 app-shell 补在它这次发的 18.4.1 节），删掉这 11 个 changeset 文件，并在 18-5 发布页加一节勘误。
- 为什么改：18.5.0 的版本提交 `b914e724` 没有消化这 11 个 changeset，代码已随 18.5.0 发出，但 CHANGELOG 和发布页都没写；其中 #33637 是破坏性变化（`os audit verify` 遇到被两个 checkpoint 同时列出的行，现在报 `listed_twice` 并失败）。按裁决 6896138728「事后补就可以」只做补记。
- 风险与回滚：纯文字，不发布代码；删掉的 changeset 若留着，下一个版本会把它们当新变化再发一遍。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`content/docs/releases/v18/18-5.mdx` 的勘误节；`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/CHANGELOG.md`（破坏性那条）；`packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md`（两条，其中一条进 Minor Changes）。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -c -E '^- (ac0b9a5|2e1e3b9|fbe349f|2673f59|0feb5ff|1e65a38|e302d32|f8f35db|e0775f7|4b5024d|81371e1): ' -- '*CHANGELOG.md'` 预期 14 个文件共 18 行；`ls .changeset/*.md | wc -l` 比 main 少 11。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（Check Changeset 会按规则保持红色，见下方 DELIBERATE CORRECTION）。

## What changes

`packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` and `content/docs/releases/` are release-owned. AGENTS.md (Documentation Guardrails) routes a factual error in a released entry, or on a releases page, to a dedicated docs-only PR, and the maintainer's ruling on this card (comment 6896138728, verbatim: 「没必要，事后补就可以：让发布流程在版本提交之前还有没消化的 changeset 时，拒绝发正式版。」) keeps only the amendment half. This is that PR. Precedent: #33925.

The 18.5.0 version commit `b914e724` (#33097) consumed 283 of the 294 changesets on its parent. The other 11 landed on `main` after the Version Packages branch point `b76df9a6` and before the merge; each one's adding commit is an ancestor of `b914e724`, and its file is byte-identical on `b914e724` and on this branch's base `bc6b7ffd`.

1. **CHANGELOG entries.** Each changeset's entry is added to the release section `b914e724` wrote for each package it names, in the stock generator's form (`- SHA7: ` + the summary, continuation lines indented two spaces), under the commit that added the changeset, in the `### Minor Changes` or `### Patch Changes` list its bump names, after the last changeset entry and before the `Updated dependencies` lines. No dependents line is invented.
2. **The 11 changeset files are deleted**, so the next version commit does not present them as new.
3. **The 18-5 page** gains `## Erratum — eleven changes 18.5.0 shipped with no CHANGELOG line [#erratum]`: #33637's FROM → TO and what an operator does, one line for each of the other nine, and a pointer from the release-facts row that said 284 were consumed. #33725 is already on the page (自动迁移, "Announced, not yet at any door"); it is checked, not repeated.

| Changeset | Package | Added to | Commit | 18-5 page |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `31908-p4b2-bounded-checkpoints` | `@objectstack/plugin-audit` | `## 18.5.0` › Patch Changes | `ac0b9a5` (#33637) | Erratum, breaking: FROM → TO, what to do, rollback note |
| `33186-managed-add-people-actions` | `@objectstack/platform-objects` | `## 18.5.0` › Patch Changes | `2e1e3b9` (#33755) | Erratum, one line |
| `33609-related-list-parent-lookup-page` | `@object-ui/console`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail` | `## 18.5.0` › Patch Changes | `fbe349f` (#33780) | Erratum, one line |
| `33649-messaging-preferences-emitting-organization` | `@objectstack/service-messaging` | `## 18.5.0` › Patch Changes | `2673f59` (#33779) | Erratum, one line |
| `33660-ai-model-picker-cost-multiplier` | `@objectstack/spec`, `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/console`; `@object-ui/app-shell` | `## 18.5.0` › Patch Changes; app-shell `## 18.4.1` › Patch Changes | `0feb5ff` (#33746) | Erratum, one line |
| `33689-ai-action-confirmation-elicited` | `@objectstack/spec` | `## 18.5.0` › Minor Changes | `1e65a38` (#33725) | Already covered (自动迁移 row), not repeated |
| `33724-install-relaxes-declared-not-null` | `@objectstack/driver-sql`, `@objectstack/cloud-connection`, `@objectstack/driver-turso` | `## 18.5.0` › Patch Changes | `e302d32` (#33769) | Erratum, one line |
| `33739-scenario-runner-effort` | `@objectstack/scenarios` | `## 18.5.0` › Patch Changes | `f8f35db` (#33767) | Erratum, one line |
| `33753-scenario-dates-follow-run-date` | `@objectstack/scenarios` | `## 18.5.0` › Patch Changes | `e0775f7` (#33776) | Erratum, one line |
| `33754-scenario-grader-written-date` | `@objectstack/scenarios` | `## 18.5.0` › Patch Changes | `4b5024d` (#33797) | Erratum, one line |
| `a2-skills-docs-32678-32825` | `@objectstack/skills` | `## 18.5.0` › Patch Changes | `81371e1` (#33355) | Erratum, one line |

**DELIBERATE CORRECTION.** This PR adds no changeset and deletes eleven (`git diff --name-status` over `.changeset/*.md`: 11 × `D`, 0 × `A`). Each deleted note is already released: its text now stands, unchanged, as the entry named in the table above, in the 18.5.0 tarballs' release section. Under ruling D on #18375 (the Check Changeset step's route 0) and `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, `skip-changeset` is not applied to a PR that deletes an existing changeset, so `Check Changeset` stays red by design; it is not a required context. The diff publishes nothing until the next release republishes the tarballs.

## Tests

No source changes, so no test suite moves. The CHANGELOG lines are generated, not hand-typed: the summary parse and the stock release-line format were re-implemented in a script and first checked against `b914e724^`: for every changeset `b914e724` consumed among the first 60 (103 package entries), the generated text is found verbatim in that package's CHANGELOG; the only miss is `31908-p4b2-bounded-checkpoints`, the unconsumed one this PR adds. The script asserts, per changeset, one adding commit, an identical blob at the tag and at the base, the release section being the top section of the version `b914e724` gave the package, and the entry not already present. The diff of every CHANGELOG is insertions only.

## Acceptance notes

1. `@object-ui/app-shell` is private and `b914e724` versioned it `18.4.1`, not `18.5.0` (the 18-5 page's release facts say so too), so its entry goes into its `## 18.4.1` section.
2. The 18-5 page still opens with "Release status: 18.4.0 is released, and 18.5.0 is not yet." and its release facts say no 18.5.0 tag or npm version exists. Both are stale since the publish. Outside this card's file surface; left for the seat (noted, not filed).
3. The changeset of #33649 has no summary line, so its entry opens `- 2673f59: Clause-②: no`, as the stock generator would have written it.

## Verification

<details><summary>Premise readings, at base bc6b7ffd and the 18.5.0 spec tag = b914e724</summary>

- `git ls-tree --name-only b914e724 .changeset/` minus `README.md` and `config.json`: 11 files, the card's list. `b914e724^` holds 294; `b914e724` deletes 283.
- For each of the 11: `git rev-parse b914e724:PATH` equals `git rev-parse bc6b7ffd:PATH`; the adding commit (`git log --diff-filter=A`, one per file) is an ancestor of `b914e724` (`merge-base --is-ancestor` exit 0, after deepening the shallow clone by 800 commits). The adding commits all fall between `b76df9a6` (the Version Packages branch point the 18-5 page names) and `b914e724`.
- Before this PR: `listed_twice`, `ac0b9a5`, `#33637` each 0 hits on `content/docs/releases/v18/18-5.mdx`.
- The erratum's wording is read from the changeset text and `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-seal/verifier.ts` (`listed_twice` fault: `checkpoint N: lists row(s) … that another checkpoint already lists`), `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` § `os audit verify` (exit 1 when two checkpoints list the same row), and the 18.5.0 entry `f4cafd5` (a late checkpoint leaves out every row a checkpoint stored in between already lists).
</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

Head `f5754612`. Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths): 99 commands, each run with stdin from `/dev/null` and its exit captured before any pipe; `--ran` reconciliation: 99 derived, 99 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

- 98 exit 0. Eleven of them first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, no `dist/` in a fresh worktree) and were re-run exit 0 after the builds they name, each under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` with VERDICT command-exit 0: the `@objectstack/lint...` closure plus the `check:i18n` extract closure (64/64 tasks), `@objectstack/client` and `client-react` (43/43), then `pnpm build` (119/119). Re-run: `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-security-posture`, spec `check:docs`, spec `check:skill-examples`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`, `check:i18n`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`; and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`, which first failed 22 files only on the missing `@objectstack/spec` `dist/` and then passed (171 files passed, 2 skipped; 5,065 tests passed).
- 1 exit 1, by design: `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main` refuses the eleven deletions as edits of existing notes (one `::error` per file). This is the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class declared above; it stays red, and so does `Check Changeset`.
- Release-text gates all exit 0 on the amended tree: `check-release-section-coverage` (plain and `--strict`), `check:release-notes`, `check:release-page-status`, `check-affected-docs`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:doc-anchors`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`.

`origin/main` moved to `159757ab` while the gates ran; the commits since the base `bc6b7ffd` touch none of this PR's paths (they add four other changesets), so no merge was taken.
</details>
